title: Looks good, a little wobbly
text:
Looks good, a little wobbly. I feel bad giving this only 3 stars because it DOES work and looks great next to my stainless steel sink and faucet. I have an under-sink RO filter faucet as well which matches, so it just sort of completes the look in my kitchen. The only thing that gets on my nerves, however, is that the bottom seems to not be as flat as it should be. That is, it sort of rocks/teeters a little bit when touched, as if the bottom is curved slightly. As soon as you touch it to pump out some soap, you expect it to stay in place but it sort of moves a little like a loose appliance on the countertop. It's not the biggest deal, but I have a glass soap pump that doesn't do this. We wanted to replace it with this chrome one because it matches our sink better, but my wife and I actually prefer the one that doesn't rock back and forth.
I want to like this, and I might keep it for the looks, but I'm going to have to settle for "its just ok".
